category: crypto market and onchain data API (assets, protocols, exchanges, timeseries)

free_tier.stated: No free market-data allowance found: every call needs an API key, the Free plan lists no Assets endpoints, and most models need a paid plan; models of the unpaid access tier work with any valid key, and the docs do not list them
free_tier.notes: The Data API enforces no rate limit and caches answers for 30 minutes. A keyless call to the tabular assets model answered HTTP 401 although the quickstart calls that model public; the legacy api.messari.io v1 endpoint answered 403 invalid auth mechanism. The Pro plan opens only the Assets endpoints; its price is not on the page.

interface_detail: GET https://api.blockworks.com/query/tabular/... and /query/timeseries/... with the X-Blockworks-API-Key header; the legacy x-messari-api-key header is still accepted
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; an MCP server, warehouse Datashares and spreadsheet plugins are sales-gated
chaining: Crypto market data from here needs a paid plan; CoinPaprika and CoinLore give keyless prices, DefiLlama keyless DeFi metrics.

limits.value: paid or permission-gated access: a free-plan key answers 403 on models of the paid tier

limits_note: Bulk path: the legacy Bulk API gave CSV or JSONL downloads by subscription tier; the current Datashares are sales-gated. Storage terms: unverified. Rate limit: none enforced by the Data API; the legacy docs gave 200 requests a minute for unpaid keys.
binding_note: Access to a model, not a request count, decides what a free key can read.

identity_cost.detail: A key is made in an account at app.blockworks.com; the sign-up form was not read, so what it asks is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A keyless call answered HTTP 401 on the assets model the quickstart calls public; the legacy host answered 403.
confidence_note: Access tiers and the pricing table are first-party; the keyless 401 contradicts the quickstart; the free key was not exercised.
